prompt: api-gateway.service on prod-edge-3 keeps flapping: systemctl status shows 'activating (auto-restart)' then it dies, and after ~20 minutes it now refuses to come up at all. Get it stable.

billing-worker.service on worker-07 'restarts' every ~6 minutes under load but the journal only says it Stopped cleanly. Customers report dropped invoice jobs. Memory accounting is on — find why it keeps dying.
After adding mount-data.service with new After=/Requires= edges, boot on db-staging-2 hangs and app-db.service never starts. systemd-analyze warns about a cycle. Untangle it so both start.
The deploy script reports cleanup-tmp.service 'enabled' and exits 0, but on ci-runner-9 it never runs and disk fills to 98%. The timer fires yet nothing happens. Find why it silently no-ops.

On-call says ingest-api.service 'went quiet' — no journal lines for the last 8 minutes during a traffic spike, so they assume it crashed. But the API is still serving 200s. Explain the gap before they restart it needlessly.

load-firewall.service (Type=oneshot) applies nftables rules and other units Requires= it. After boot on edge-fw-1 those units report the firewall dependency as 'inactive', and manually starting a dependent re-applies the rules a second time. Stop the double-apply.

metrics-collector.socket on mon-2 shows LISTEN on :9100 and looks healthy, but scrapes intermittently get connection-refused and the .service logs 'address already in use' on activation. Fix the flapping scrape endpoint.

stream-processor.service (Type=notify, WatchdogSec=30) on stream-4 gets SIGABRT-restarted every ~30s even though its own logs show it happily processing batches. Throughput is sawtoothing — stop the watchdog kills.

After packaging nginx as nginx-edge.service (Type=forking), systemctl start hangs ~90s then reports 'failed', yet ps on lb-11 shows the nginx master plus workers serving traffic on :80. Reconcile systemd's view with reality.

schema-migrate.service runs a ~4-minute Flyway migration on release. On db-prod-1 it gets SIGTERM at exactly 1m30s and the release marks 'migration failed', leaving the schema half-applied. Let the migration finish.

ci-builder.service on build-12 throws 'fork: Resource temporarily unavailable' once ~510 build jobs are in flight, but the host has free RAM and the login ulimit -u is 64000. Parallel builds fail — find the real cap.

socket-relay.service on relay-3 starts logging 'accept: too many open files' and dropping connections once it crosses ~1024 concurrent sockets, even though /etc/security/limits.conf sets nofile 1048576. Raise the real fd ceiling.

nightly-backup.timer on backup-1 was supposed to run at 02:30 daily, but the last snapshot is 3 days old. systemctl is-active on the .timer returns 'active'. Find why the backup never ran and recover the missed window.

After a host rebuild, payments-api.service on pay-2 starts 'successfully' but every request 500s with 'DATABASE_URL is empty'. The env file path didn't change. Find why config isn't loading and restore it.
